evidence.r1: The large Active alerts content sidebar uses the same translucent material as the floating controls.
evidence.r2: Alert cards and vehicle-platter actions use plain fills inside the enclosing material rather than stacked glass.
evidence.r3: Route, status, search, zoom, alerts and the temporary vehicle platter each serve a distinct operational purpose.
evidence.r4: Toolbars, alerts and the selected-vehicle platter share a single pale frosted appearance.
evidence.r5: No clear material is visible; map-facing surfaces have substantial pale frosting.
evidence.r6: Action and filter backgrounds are neutral; coloured status dots act as keys rather than tinted control backgrounds.
evidence.r7: Soft map colours show through the normal alerts surface and are suppressed in its reduced-transparency version.
evidence.r8: Bars, vehicle markers, cards and small actions use consistent fixed rounded rectangles.
evidence.r9: The alert cards and camera image step down their radii with inset spacing inside the rounded sidebar.
evidence.r10: The Hold, Call and incident controls use compact rounded rectangles appropriate to the dense desktop interface.
evidence.r11: Routes, statuses and search occupy three distinct top groups, with zoom controls separately grouped.
evidence.r12: The route and status buttons are text controls, while zoom icons occupy a separate background.
evidence.r13: Glass surrounds the complete filter and vehicle-control groups rather than their individual labels.
evidence.r14: Related filters share continuous surfaces, with deliberate open map space separating unrelated groups.
evidence.r15: The alert list clips at the sidebar bottom without a visible scroll-edge fade or separator treatment.
evidence.r16: The map grid, rivers and routes provide varied imagery beneath the floating surfaces.
evidence.r17: Route lines and vehicle markers disappear underneath the right-hand alert sidebar at rest.
evidence.r18: The pale control surfaces have readable dark labels, but no dark appearance establishes both-mode contrast.
evidence.r19: The reduced-transparency console remains legible, but increased contrast and reduced-motion support are not shown.
evidence.r20: The map reaches all window edges with the toolbars and sidebar floating above it.
evidence.r21: Vehicles run directly beneath the alert sidebar with no visible safe-area accommodation or background-only extension.
evidence.r22: The map continues directly beneath the glass controls without a separate backing strip or darkening layer.
evidence.r23: The selected-vehicle still reveals placement but not an emergence animation, morph or pointer flex.
evidence.r24: The status filter contains saturated blue, amber and red symbols within the control layer.
evidence.r25: Dark route and action labels are distinct from the pale map colours transmitted by the controls.
